item.title: They paid $470,000 for a ‘boring’ business. Within days, almost everything went wrong
item.description: After one couple’s new business turned into a nightmare, here’s how they turned it around. Andrea Palacio and her husband thought they were playing it safe. In a search for a passive income business, they paid $470,000 for a South Florida landscaping company a few years ago. It was, in their words, a “boring business,” which was hands-off and had good cash flow. Within days of the deal closing, though, the seller vanished, 10 of the 12 employees quit, and revenue took a sudden dive from $70,000 per month to $40,000....
